# Seed Seeker

> Seed Seeker is a browser tool for finding and analyzing Shattered Pixel Dungeon seeds. Its Rust seed finder runs as WebAssembly in the browser, so searches stay on your device.

The app has two modes:

- **Find** searches for seeds that match a query: items such as weapons, armor, wands and rings, plus quests, rooms and challenges. Simple edits one item list; Advanced edits the full query.
- **Analyze** opens one seed per tab and shows what the seed generates, with floor maps. It can also read a seed from a screenshot.

## Links

- [Seed Seeker](https://seedseeker.nerdcoder.xyz/): the app.
- Query share links have the form `https://seedseeker.nerdcoder.xyz/#q=CODE` and open the shared query in Find.
- Seed links have the form `https://seedseeker.nerdcoder.xyz/?scout=ABC-DEF-GHI` and open that seed in Analyze.
